description: Evaluation cases for the canister-status-monitoring skill. Tests whether an agent, asked to watch an IC canister's control plane, correctly reads the keyless dashboard API, detects controller/module-hash changes, handles unindexed (404) and invalid-id (422) responses, and knows the live running state is controller-gated.

output_evals.name: Detect a controller change from public metadata
output_evals.prompt: Keep an eye on canister rdmx6-jaaaa-aaaaa-aaadq-cai and tell me if its controllers ever change. What do you poll and does it need a key?
expected_behaviors: Reads the public IC dashboard API (ic-api.internetcomputer.org/api/v3/canisters/<id>) for the controller set
States this is keyless - no identity required for control-plane metadata
Compares the current controllers against the last-seen set and alerts on any add/remove
Frames an unexpected controller change as a takeover signal worth immediate attention

output_evals.name: Detect an upgrade via module_hash
output_evals.prompt: How do I tell if this canister was upgraded without an announcement?
expected_behaviors: Tracks module_hash from the dashboard API and alerts when it changes
Identifies the latest upgrade as upgrades[0] (the API lists newest first)
Treats a module_hash change as an unreviewed upgrade to surface

output_evals.name: Unindexed vs invalid id
output_evals.prompt: The dashboard API returns 404 for one canister id and 422 for another. What do those mean for monitoring?
expected_behaviors: 404 means the canister is not indexed (or was deleted/de-indexed) - recorded as a state, not a hard error
422 means a malformed/invalid canister id - a bad input, not a change to alert on
Does not report either as a controller/upgrade change

output_evals.name: Live running state is controller-gated
output_evals.prompt: Can you also report whether the canister is Running or Stopped?
expected_behaviors: Explains the live running state comes from the management canister canister_status, callable only by a controller
States there is no public endpoint for it
Says it needs a controller identity (dfx canister status or an ic-agent call signed by a controller) and otherwise reports control-plane facts only

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should load this skill vs. ones that should not.
should_trigger: Monitor my canister's controllers for changes
Alert me if my canister gets upgraded
Did someone take over my canister's control?
should_not_trigger: How do I deploy a canister to mainnet?
Write a Candid interface for my canister
How do I top up my canister with cycles?
Set up Internet Identity for my dapp
